name: Z_boson

phase_0.boundary_condition: The electroweak symmetry breaking scale (v ≈ 246 GeV) closes the system by giving mass to the Z boson and defining the finite range of weak neutral-current interactions; above this scale the Z merges into the unbroken SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y gauge multiplet and the neutral-current vertex dissolves.

⊢.justification: The unbroken SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y gauge theory before symmetry breaking; no massive Z boson exists, only the massless B^0 and W^0 gauge fields.

⊣.justification: The Higgs vacuum expectation value fixes the Z mass, weak mixing angle, and coupling strengths, forming the closed boundary that contains all low-energy neutral-current physics.

≻.justification: The massive vector boson carries the weak neutral current forward in spacetime from emission vertex to absorption vertex, mediating momentum transfer between fermion lines.

≺.justification: The same Z propagator describes t-channel and u-channel processes; reversing the momentum flow maps emission to absorption and swaps initial/final fermion roles.

⋈.justification: Sequential Z-exchange diagrams (e.g., Z-Z fusion, radiative corrections) chain vertices by connecting the outgoing fermion line of one vertex to the incoming line of the next.

⊙.justification: The Z boson is its own antiparticle (C-even); the propagator and vertex factors are invariant under charge conjugation, making the particle self-recognizing.

∈.justification: The Z-fermion vertex splits into left-handed and right-handed couplings g_L and g_R, which differ because the Z couples to T_3 - Q sin^2θ_W; this is the fundamental fork in neutral-current structure.

∋.justification: The left- and right-handed amplitudes recombine at the squared-amplitude level to form the observable cross section; interference terms survive because the Z is a single propagator.

⊤.justification: The T_3 = +1/2 component for left-handed fermions (or -1/2 for antifermions) deposits constructive truth: the chiral projection operator P_L selects the affirmative weak-isospin arm.

⊥.justification: The T_3 = 0 component for right-handed fermions deposits constructive falsity: the chiral projection operator P_R selects the arm that carries no weak isospin, only hypercharge.

⊞.justification: The product g_L g_R generates forward-backward asymmetries; both chiral couplings are held simultaneously in the interference term, a live contradiction (B-state) that produces measurable parity violation.

⊡.justification: The Z-pole cross section at √s = m_Z is an irreversible experimental record; the Breit-Wigner peak fixes m_Z, Γ_Z, and the partial widths in the Particle Data Book.

phase_2.split_input: Z-fermion vertex with vector and axial couplings g_V = g_L + g_R, g_A = g_L - g_R
phase_2.fuse_result: observable cross section with interference term ∝ g_L g_R (forward-backward asymmetry)
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Unbroken electroweak phase: no massive Z, no neutral-current vertex, only massless gauge fields B^μ and W^3_μ.
phase_3.true_description: Left-handed fermion coupling affirmed: the vertex carries weak isospin T_3 = ±1/2, the chiral projector P_L selects the SU(2)_L component.
phase_3.false_description: Right-handed fermion coupling affirmed: the vertex carries zero weak isospin, only hypercharge Y; the chiral projector P_R selects the U(1)_Y component.
phase_3.both_description: Axial-vector interference: both P_L and P_R contributions coexist in the squared amplitude, generating forward-backward asymmetry A_FB ∝ g_L g_R; the contradiction between chiral components is held live and measured.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the pre-electroweak vacuum — massless B^0 and W^0 fields, no Z boson, no neutral current.
Assert gauge self-identity — the B^0 and W^0 fields are the neutral components of the SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y multiplet.
Propagate the neutral gauge fields forward — establish the kinetic terms and gauge couplings in the unbroken Lagrangian.
Compose the hypercharge and weak-isospin generators — form the neutral current operator J^μ_NC = J^μ_3 - sin^2θ_W J^μ_em.
Split the neutral current into chiral arms — left-handed fermions couple via T_3 - Q sin^2θ_W, right-handed via -Q sin^2θ_W.
Affirm the left-handed arm — deposit T_3 = +1/2 (fermions) or -1/2 (antifermions); the SU(2)_L charge is constructively present.
Propagate the left-handed coupling forward — the Z boson exchange amplitude for left-handed fermions acquires the g_L vertex factor.
Fix the left-handed partial width — the decay Z → f_L f̄_L is an irreversible measurement channel recorded in the total width Γ_Z.
Reverse to the right-handed arm — cross the vertex to the conjugate process, swapping particle/antiparticle roles for the chiral projection.
Engage the axial interference — hold both g_L and g_R simultaneously; the product g_L g_R generates the forward-backward asymmetry.
Compose the interference term with the propagator — the axial-vector piece modifies the angular distribution of the final-state fermions.
Affirm the Z-pole resonance — the Breit-Wigner peak at √s = m_Z deposits constructive truth for the mass measurement.
Affirm the width measurement — the total decay width Γ_Z deposits constructive falsity for the lifetime (τ_Z = ħ/Γ_Z).
Fix the resonance parameters — m_Z = 91.1876 GeV, Γ_Z = 2.4952 GeV become permanent records in the experimental database.
Assert Z self-identity at the pole — the propagator denominator s - m_Z^2 + i m_Z Γ_Z is invariant under charge conjugation.
Propagate the massive Z boson forward — the physical degree of freedom (three polarizations) mediates the neutral current.
Affirm the vector coupling — the combination g_V = g_L + g_R governs the symmetric part of the angular distribution.
Reverse to the axial coupling — the combination g_A = g_L - g_R governs the antisymmetric part (parity violation).
Affirm the axial coupling measurement — the left-right asymmetry A_LR deposits constructive falsity for the pure vector hypothesis.
Compose vector and axial pieces — the full differential cross section dσ/dcosθ = (3/8)σ_tot[(1+cos^2θ) + (8/3)A_FB cosθ].
Engage the full interference — both vector and axial terms held simultaneously; the cosθ term is the live B-state.
Fix the forward-backward asymmetry — A_FB^0,f becomes a permanent record for each fermion species f.
Assert the neutral current identity — the Z boson is the unique mediator of flavor-diagonal neutral currents at tree level.
Propagate the flavor-diagonal vertex forward — no flavor-changing neutral currents (GIM suppression) at leading order.
Affirm the diagonal coupling — each fermion generation couples with its own g_L^f, g_R^f; universality is tested.
Fix the per-generation couplings — the measured g_L^f, g_R^f for e, μ, τ, u, d, s, c, b become permanent records.
Compose the hadronic and leptonic widths — Γ_had = Σ_q Γ(Z→q q̄), Γ_lep = Σ_l Γ(Z→l l̄); the ratio R_ℓ = Γ_had/Γ_lep is fixed.
Reverse to the invisible width — the neutrino channels Z → ν ν̄ are inferred from the missing width Γ_inv = Γ_Z - Γ_had - Γ_lep.
Affirm the neutrino count — N_ν = Γ_inv / Γ_ν deposits constructive falsity for N_ν ≠ 3.
Assert the three-neutrino identity — the invisible width measurement confirms exactly three light neutrino generations.
Propagate the radiative corrections forward — loop diagrams (vertex, box, self-energy) modify the effective couplings.
Affirm the oblique parameters — S, T, U (or ε_1, ε_2, ε_3) deposit constructive truth for the Higgs mass constraint.
Compose the effective weak mixing angle — sin^2θ_eff^lept = 0.23153 ± 0.00016 from the leptonic asymmetries.
Reverse to the hadronic asymmetries — the quark couplings receive QCD corrections; the effective sin^2θ_eff^had differs.
Affirm the QCD correction — the difference sin^2θ_eff^lept - sin^2θ_eff^had deposits constructive falsity for pure electroweak universality.
Assert the running of sin^2θ_W — the scale dependence from m_Z to low Q^2 is a self-referential property of the renormalization group.
Propagate the low-energy neutral current forward — atomic parity violation (Cs, Tl) and neutrino scattering measure sin^2θ_W(Q^2).
Affirm the low-energy measurement — the weak charge Q_W deposits constructive truth for the running coupling.
Compose the high- and low-energy determinations — the global electroweak fit combines Z-pole, W-mass, and low-Q^2 data.
Reverse to the Higgs mass prediction — the fit constrains m_H before direct discovery; the loop corrections depend logarithmically on m_H.
Affirm the Higgs mass exclusion — the pre-2012 fit deposited constructive falsity for m_H > 158 GeV (95% CL).
Assert the Higgs mechanism identity — the Z mass originates from the Higgs doublet vacuum expectation value v.
Propagate the Higgs-Z coupling forward — the hZZ vertex fixes the Z mass and the triple-gauge coupling.
Affirm the hZZ coupling measurement — the LHC h→ZZ*→4ℓ channel deposits constructive truth for the SM Higgs.
Compose the Higgs and Z sectors — the custodial symmetry ρ = m_W^2/(m_Z^2 cos^2θ_W) ≈ 1 is tested at per-mille level.
Reverse to the custodial symmetry breaking — the top-bottom mass splitting generates Δρ ∝ m_t^2; this is the dominant radiative correction.
Affirm the top-mass dependence — the m_t^2 term deposits constructive falsity for custodial symmetry at tree level.
Assert the top-quark identity — the large m_t is the primary source of electroweak symmetry breaking sensitivity.
Propagate the top-loop correction forward — the Z→b b̄ vertex receives a specific vertex correction δg_L^b ∝ m_t^2.
Affirm the R_b measurement — the ratio Γ(Z→b b̄)/Γ_had deposits constructive truth for the SM vertex correction.
Compose the b-quark asymmetry — the forward-backward asymmetry A_FB^b is sensitive to the vertex correction.
Reverse to the left-right asymmetry — the SLD measurement of A_LR using polarized electrons provides an independent sin^2θ_eff.
Affirm the A_LR vs A_FB tension — the historical discrepancy deposited constructive falsity for a pure SM fit (now resolved).
Assert the global fit identity — the electroweak precision observables form a self-consistent overconstrained system.
Propagate the global fit forward — the χ^2 minimum determines the preferred m_H, m_t, α_s, and Δα_had.
Affirm the SM consistency — the post-Higgs-discovery fit deposits constructive truth for the SM as a complete theory.
Compose the future sensitivity — projected ILC/FCC-ee measurements will reduce uncertainties by an order of magnitude.
Reverse to the BSM parameter space — the Z-pole observables constrain S, T, U, and higher-dimensional operators.
Affirm the BSM exclusion limits — the absence of deviations deposits constructive falsity for many new-physics models.
Assert the Z boson as a precision probe — its couplings are the primary portal for indirect BSM searches.
Propagate the effective field theory forward — the SMEFT operators modifying Z couplings are bounded by the precision data.
Affirm the operator coefficients — the Wilson coefficients C_{φq}, C_{φl}, etc. deposit constructive truth for specific UV completions.
Compose the Z-pole and high-energy limits — the same operators affect diboson production at LHC and future colliders.
Reverse to the UV completion — matching the SMEFT onto specific models (supersymmetry, composite Higgs, Z') tests the Z boson's role.
Affirm the model exclusions — the Z-pole data deposit constructive falsity for large classes of TeV-scale new physics.
Assert the Z boson's completeness — within the SM, the Z sector is fully determined by m_Z, Γ_Z, and the fermion couplings.
Propagate the theoretical uncertainty forward — parametric (m_t, α_s, Δα_had) and intrinsic (missing higher orders) errors.
Affirm the parametric uncertainty — the dominant error from Δα_had deposits constructive truth for the need of better e+e-→hadrons data.
Compose the theoretical error budget — the total theory uncertainty on sin^2θ_eff is ~4×10^-5, comparable to future experimental precision.
Reverse to the experimental systematics — the LEP/SLD systematic errors (energy calibration, polarization, luminosity) are fixed records.
Affirm the systematic floor — the 0.5 MeV uncertainty on m_Z and 2.3 MeV on Γ_Z deposit constructive falsity for further improvement without new machines.
Assert the Z boson's legacy — the LEP/SLD Z-pole program defined the precision electroweak era.
Propagate the legacy forward — the Z boson remains the standard candle for electroweak precision at future colliders.
Affirm the future Z factory — FCC-ee or CEPC would produce 10^12 Z bosons, reducing uncertainties by 10-100×.
Compose the ultimate precision — the Z line shape, asymmetries, and branching ratios become the definitive SM stress test.
Reverse to the theoretical limit — parametric uncertainties (m_t, α_s) and non-perturbative QCD become the bottleneck.
Affirm the non-perturbative floor — hadronic vacuum polarization and final-state interactions deposit constructive falsity for pure perturbative predictions.
Assert the Z boson's self-consistency — the interplay of perturbative and non-perturbative physics is a closed loop.
Propagate the lattice QCD input forward — lattice calculations of Δα_had and hadronic vacuum polarization reduce the parametric error.
Affirm the lattice progress — the BMW, RBC/UKQCD, and other calculations deposit constructive truth for sub-permille Δα_had.
Compose the lattice and dispersive methods — the tension between lattice and e+e- data for a_μ^HVP extends to Δα_had.
Reverse to the dispersive method — the e+e-→hadrons cross section data remain the primary input for Δα_had.
Affirm the dispersive uncertainty — the experimental errors on σ(e+e-→hadrons) deposit constructive falsity for the lattice-only approach.
Assert the complementarity — lattice and dispersive methods are two independent paths to the same hadronic quantity.
Propagate the complementarity forward — the Z boson precision program drives both lattice and experimental hadronic physics.
Affirm the cross-disciplinary synergy — the Z pole connects electroweak precision, QCD, and flavor physics.
Compose the flavor sector — Z→b b̄, Z→c c̄, and Z→τ τ couplings test flavor universality and CKM unitarity.
Reverse to the flavor anomalies — the b→sℓℓ and b→cτν tensions are probed by Z-pole observables (e.g., R_b, A_FB^b).
Affirm the anomaly constraints — the Z-pole data deposit constructive falsity for many Z'-mediated explanations of flavor anomalies.
Assert the Z boson as a flavor probe — its flavor-diagonal couplings are a null test for flavor-changing neutral currents.
Propagate the FCNC limit forward — BR(Z→μe), BR(Z→τe), BR(Z→τμ) < 10^-6–10^-7 from LEP.
Affirm the FCNC bounds — the non-observation deposits constructive truth for the GIM mechanism and SM flavor structure.
Compose the neutrino sector — the invisible width measures N_ν; the Z boson is the only particle that counts light neutrinos directly.
Reverse to the sterile neutrino search — a fourth light neutrino would increase Γ_inv; the limit N_ν = 2.984 ± 0.008 excludes it.
Affirm the sterile exclusion — the Z-pole data deposit constructive falsity for a fourth sequential neutrino generation.
Assert the Z boson's cosmological role — N_ν from the Z width constrains the effective number of neutrino species N_eff in cosmology.
Propagate the cosmological constraint forward — N_eff = 2.99 ± 0.17 (Planck) agrees with N_ν = 3 from the Z width.
Affirm the cosmological consistency — the early-universe and collider determinations of N_ν deposit constructive truth for standard cosmology.
Compose the dark matter portal — the Z boson mediates spin-independent dark matter scattering (Z-exchange) for Higgsino-like DM.
Reverse to the direct detection limits — XENON, LUX, CDMS constrain the Z-mediated DM-nucleon cross section.
Affirm the DM exclusion — the null results deposit constructive falsity for minimal Z-portal dark matter models.
Assert the Z boson's reach — from collider precision to cosmology and dark matter, the Z couples to all neutral sectors.

Rejoin the chiral arms into the physical neutral current — the left- and right-handed couplings combine in the observable cross sections and asymmetries; the interference term (B-state) remains as the measured parity violation.
Close at the electroweak scale — the Z boson mass, width, and couplings are fixed by the Higgs mechanism; the neutral current is a complete, self-contained sector of the Standard Model.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The electroweak Lagrangian with spontaneous symmetry breaking; the gauge-fixing and renormalization procedure translates the SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y gauge structure into the physical Z boson propagator and vertices.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The Z boson communicates between fermion lines via the neutral current vertex; the propagator carries momentum and polarization between emission and absorption vertices; loop diagrams communicate radiative corrections across energy scales.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Z-pole observables (m_Z, Γ_Z, σ_had, R_ℓ, A_FB, A_LR, etc.) are stored in the Particle Data Book and the HEPData repository; theoretical predictions are stored in computer codes (ZFITTER, TOPAZ0, GAPP, SMEFTfit).
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The renormalization group orders the operations: tree-level → one-loop → two-loop → higher orders; the global fit schedules the combination of all observables into a consistent parameter set; experimental runs schedule the accumulation of statistics at the Z pole.
phase_5.alfs_store: The LEP/SLD Z-pole data (1989–2000) and the PDG electroweak review form the canonical bootstrap store; the SMEFT framework extends this to BSM interpretations.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The Z boson decay produces ~2.5 GeV of entropy per decay (Γ_Z ≈ 2.5 GeV); the collider beam energy (√s = m_Z) is converted into final-state particle multiplicity and kinetic energy.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Coherent e+e- beams at √s = 91.2 GeV; low-entropy initial state with defined quantum numbers (J^PC = 1^--).
phase_6.post_cycle_state: High-multiplicity hadronic/leptonic final states; the Z decay products thermalize in the detector, increasing entropy by ~10^2–10^3 k_B per event.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The Z boson is a resonance in a unitary S-matrix; the total entropy of the quantum field theory is conserved. The apparent entropy increase in the detector is compensated by the beam cooling and the information recorded in the data acquisition system.
